specs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / product-mockup. A transparent-alpha photoreal 3D radio cutout for MUVS gallery. CRITICAL CAMERA CHANGE: render the complete receiver STRICTLY FRONT-ON, optical axis perpendicular to the front panel, orthographic-like product elevation, ZERO yaw, ZERO pitch, ZERO roll. No visible left or right side panel, no visible top face of the cabinet, NO three-quarter or isometric perspective. Front edges and horizontal bottom are level and parallel to the image frame; all rubber feet/supports sit at exactly the same image height on ONE horizontal baseline. The radio remains a thick believable manufactured 3D object through materials, bevels and recesses, but viewed head-on. Full antenna and handle visible, entire object isolated on genuinely transparent alpha; no floor, no ground shadow, no pedestal, no environment or props, no opaque rectangle/checkerboard, no watermark/brand logo. Square composition and ~4–6% transparent border on every side; bottom of feet ~94–95% image height, body fills ~88–92% width so it matches the gallery's existing scale. Soft neutral upper-left product lighting, readable edges on a gray/white website. Clean antialiasing. One receiver only. Input image 1 is the existing ROOTS receiver, identity/material reference and edit target. Preserve the beloved worn 1970s walnut, aged ivory front, warm brown woven speaker grille, large metal knobs, analog FM scale and carrying handle; transform it to exact frontal view and level feet. Weathered small ROOTS REGGAE and DUB stickers plus a faded red/gold/green stripe belong on the FRONT cabinet trim since no side face is visible; don't obscure speaker or tuning window. Honest tiny scratches and warm patina, cared for and functional. Keep era and physical detail, not the old angled perspective. No cannabis, no extra modern screens, no tags added to every inch.

Tasteful rubbed corners, slight wear, cohesive silver/blue with small acid-lime sticker accents. No extra loose cassette, no other props.
